summary_en: Year-end dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised by 1 yen to 26 yen per share, bringing full-year dividend to 51 yen per share from previously guided 50 yen, reflecting performance through the second quarter.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, Zeria Pharmaceutical raised its year-end dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased the per-share dividend by 1 yen from the previously guided 25 yen to 26 yen. This brings the full-year dividend to 51 yen per share, compared to the prior guidance of 50 yen. The adjustment reflects the company's performance through the second quarter.

The company regards stable and continuous dividend payments to shareholders as a core management priority. The revision was decided at a board meeting held on the announcement date. The prior-year period (fiscal year ended March 31, 2026) had paid 49 yen in total annual dividends (24 yen interim plus 25 yen year-end).
